from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now = datetime.now()
print('now', now.isoformat())
# compute upcoming Saturday/Sunday (this weekend) relative to now
# weekday(): Monday=0 ... Sunday=6
weekday = now.weekday()
# days until Saturday
days_until_sat = (5 - weekday) % 7
sat = (now + timedelta(days=days_until_sat)).date()
sun = (sat + timedelta(days=1))
print('sat', sat, 'sun', sun)
# also compute 90 days back for email search window
min_date = (now - timedelta(days=90)).date()
print('min_date', min_date)
